metadata.summary: Reviewed OSS Gantt and calendar candidates against the Svelte 5 architecture. Recommend evaluating MIT SVAR Gantt plus EventCalendar; FullCalendar Standard is the fallback. SVAR Calendar Agenda and Schedule-X v4 drag/resize require Premium. Preserve versioned date proposals, all-day semantics and shared editing. Research evidence: progress/2026-09-07-gantt-calendar-research.md. No adoption or device/performance acceptance claimed.
